findings.title: Balanced consequence closes on no recourse
findings.claim: The repeated measure gives life and death parallel weight, and the later search clause closes the consequence by denying effective aid against its source.
findings.mechanism: Before: Two punishments are listed and abandonment is added. After: A balanced consequence spans both registers and culminates in the impossibility of effective intervention against its source.
